name: Notion
shortDescription: Notes and workspace app with AI features.
bestFor: Keeping notes, tasks and documents in one place, with AI to search and write
about: Notion is a workspace for notes, documents, task lists and simple databases. Students use it for study notes, and teams use it as a company wiki and project tracker.
Notion AI can write and summarise inside your pages, answer questions about everything in your workspace, and take meeting notes.
features: Notion AI for writing and summaries
Search across your workspace and connected apps

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Create a free account at notion.com.

howToUse.title: Start from a template
howToUse.text: Pick a template such as a student planner or task list.

howToUse.title: Add your pages
howToUse.text: Type / to add headings, lists, tables and more.

howToUse.title: Use AI on a page
howToUse.text: Press space on an empty line or select text to ask AI to write, summarise or translate.

tips: Keep a simple structure: one page per subject or project.
Use database views (board, calendar) to see tasks in different ways.
limitations: Full AI features need the Business plan.
It can feel slow with very large workspaces.
freePlanDetails: AI features only as a trial.
pricingNote: US prices. App store prices in Pakistan may be different.
